تزدقمون (form VIII)
# تَزْدَقِمُونَ (tazdaqimūna) /taz.da.qi.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
# تُزْدَقَمُونَ (tuzdaqamūna) /tuz.da.qa.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَقَمَ (izdaqama)
